freshProof.title: Confirm it’s you
freshProof.description: To keep your account safe, enter a fresh code before this change.
freshProof.noMethod: This account has no email address or authenticator app to send a code to. Write to us and we’ll help.
freshProof.emailSent: We sent a code to <ltr>{email}</ltr>. It works for 10 minutes.
freshProof.wait: You can ask for a new code in {time}

errors.fresh_proof_required: To make this change, first confirm it’s you with a fresh code.
errors.code_wait: One moment before a new code – try again in a few seconds.
errors.no_email_for_code: This account has no email address to send a code to.
errors.email_unavailable: We couldn’t send the email right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.invalid_code: That code isn’t right. Check it and try again.
errors.code_expired: This code has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many tries. Ask for a new code.
errors.totp_invalid_code: That code isn’t right. Enter the current code from your app.
errors.totp_locked: Too many wrong codes today. You can reset the count with an email code.
errors.recovery_code_invalid: That recovery code isn’t right, or it was already used.
errors.not_locked: Your account isn’t locked. Enter the code from your app.
errors.contact_email_unchanged: That’s already your email for notifications.
errors.contact_email_needs_code: A new address is saved only after a code sent to it.
errors.totp_not_enabled: 2-step login isn’t on for this account.
errors.logout_failed: We couldn’t log you out. Check your connection and try again.

challenge.useRecovery: No access to your app? Use a recovery code
challenge.useApp: Back to the code from the app
challenge.logoutError: We couldn’t log you out. Check your connection and try again.
challenge.recoveryIntro: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you turned on 2-step login. Each code works once.
challenge.recoverySubmit: Log in with a recovery code
challenge.recoveryLeft: {count, plural, one {You have {count} recovery code left} other {You have {count} recovery codes left}}. We suggest moving 2-step login to a new phone in Settings.
challenge.lockedTitle: Logging in is locked until tomorrow
challenge.lockedText: 20 wrong codes were entered today. A code sent to your email resets the count – after that you still need the code from your app or a recovery code.
challenge.wait: You can ask for a new code in {time}
challenge.unlocked: The count was reset. Now enter the code from your app.
challenge.continueText: You came from a link on another site. To keep the account safe, tap to continue.
challenge.staffAgain: To keep the admin panel safe, enter the code from your app again in this browser.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.intro: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you in instead of the code from the app. Keep them somewhere safe – not on the same phone.
recovery.once: The codes are shown only once. Each code works once.
recovery.savedCheck: I saved the codes somewhere safe
recovery.fileIntro: Each code logs you in once, instead of the code from your authenticator app. Never share them with anyone.
recovery.fileFooter: Making new codes in your account settings cancels these.
recovery.recommendBusiness: Strongly recommended for hotels and businesses: an SMS code alone can be stolen with a SIM swap. An authenticator app keeps the account safe even then.
recovery.left: {count, plural, one {{count} recovery code left} other {{count} recovery codes left}}
recovery.newText: Your old codes no longer work.

contactEmail.hint: A new address is confirmed with a code we send to it.
contactEmail.sendCode: Send a code to this address
contactEmail.removed: Your email for notifications was removed.
contactEmail.sent: We sent a code to <ltr>{email}</ltr>. Enter it to save the address.
contactEmail.wait: You can ask for a new code in {time}
contactEmail.savedSignedOut: The address was saved. We logged you out on your other devices.
